items.title: Étale closed immersions are complemented open embeddings
items.statement_scope: Whole Proposition 1.2.8: let X be an ∞-topos containing a (−1)-truncated object U, and let i*: X/U → X be the corresponding closed immersion of ∞-topoi. The following conditions are equivalent: (1) the geometric morphism i* is étale; (2) the (−1)-truncated object U is complemented, that is, there exists an object U′ ∈ X such that the coproduct U ⨿ U′ is a final object of X.
standard_prerequisites: The left adjoint i! to the pullback functor i* and its interaction with finite products.
Truncation τ≤−1 and the characterization of final objects among (−1)-truncated 0-connective objects.
items.difficulty_reason: Rule author-work-bearing-core-v1-20261114: H2 because the proof at author PDF p. 14 constructs i! and V = i!i*1, shows U × V is initial, sets U′ = τ≤−1V, and uses the unit map 1 → U ⨿ V to prove that U ⨿ U′ is a final object; the converse is immediate. This is a non-routine ∞-topos argument, but a supporting clopen-immersion criterion rather than the H3 main comparison.

difficulty_evidence.bearing_core: Construction of the complement via i!i*1, τ≤−1, and finality of U ⨿ U′.
